No rigorously established exact invariant of natural object whose value was unknown and reusable (d(36,11) remains 12-vs-13 open). This is textbook restatement / tiny unmotivated gain / unexplained enumeration case: correct and new yet not worth finding later. Missing substantive result is intrinsic, not a bounded presentation gap.
